entities.summary: "Dangerous" is a song by Cascada, released as a single in 2009 from their third studio album Evacuate the Dancefloor. It was the second single released in the UK and Ireland from the album but the third overall. The music video was uploaded to YouTube by the UK record company All Around the World on August 17, 2009, and the single was released in the United Kingdom on October 12, 2009.
